map.气缸速度由排气侧节流控制：排气口径越小、背压越高，活塞运动越慢；口径全开时速度可: Cylinder speed is controlled by exhaust-side throttling: smaller port → higher backpressure → slower piston; fully open port reaches m/s. Practice uses exhaust-throttle valves.
map.实际推力应大于负载，建议留 1.5~2 倍余量。水平推送还需计入导轨摩擦与启停惯: Actual force should exceed load; keep 1.5–2× margin. Horizontal push also counts guide friction and start/stop inertia; near the limit, enlarge bore or raise pressure.
map.缓冲腔吸收能量小于负载动能时，活塞末端会撞击端盖，产生噪声、振动并加速密封与缸体: When cushion absorbed energy < load kinetic energy, the piston end hits the cap, causing noise, vibration and faster seal/barrel wear. Increase cushion stroke or add a hydraulic cushion.
